ValidationRule.description: If Inquiry record type have the case reason as 'Promotion', then promotion field is mandatory.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> 'Nexus Data Loader', $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", TEXT($User.UserType) <> "AutomatedProcess", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Latam_Inquiry", ISPICKVAL(Reason, "Promotion (I)"), ISBLANK(Promotions_Name__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Promotion must be selected when Reason is "Promotion (I)"
